current.text: Projected Knicks starter at forward next to Brunson, Bridges, Hart and Towns.
His usage was just under 20 percent last season, in about 33 minutes per game.
Expected to stay the third option behind Brunson and Towns. He should have more big scoring nights when they rest, but he is not projected to average 25 points.
The Knicks won the title over the Spurs. In the Finals he attacked Wembanyama directly with success and was the next best player for chunks of those games.
Experts expect the Knicks to be cautious with his minutes after the long title run.
The Knicks are expected to trim starters' minutes and give more rest on back-to-backs early in the season.
One expert is slightly worried about a championship hangover: a minute or two less per game and a small rise in injury risk.
He has the widest outcome range of his draft round, from about 22nd best case to 89th worst case, mostly because his steals vary. The expert still feels confident in him.
Maybe slightly undervalued in category leagues at a Yahoo rank of 71 and an ADP of 65.
He went for 16 USD in an expert auction mock draft.
Worth close to 20 USD in an auction, so 16 USD is still a good price.

durable.text: Much better in category leagues than in points leagues.
Streaky: hot stretches are followed by weeks of inconsistency.
He has had knee and ankle problems over his career, but he has stayed healthy for two seasons with the Knicks.
Steals are his best category and threes are second, both clearly above average for a forward. He has no weak category.

note: Anunoby's projections have no weak category. His best are steals (z +1.6) and threes (z +0.9), so he fits any build as a forward. Our league paid 15 USD for him last season. The sites value him between 6 USD (ESPN) and 14 USD (Yahoo), and the latest expert puts him near 20 USD, so 15 to 18 USD is a fair target. Early on, watch how the Knicks limit his minutes and rest him on back-to-backs over the first 30 or so games, and check whether his steals hold, since they drive most of his range.
